title: Seeing Fast and Slow: Learning the Flow of Time
summary: A deep learning framework designed to perceive and control temporal dynamics in video using audio-visual self-supervision. It enables precise playback speed adjustment and high-fidelity temporal super-resolution by learning physical motion constraints.
research_notes: Uses audio pitch shifts to supervise temporal learning and enforces motion equivariance to solve temporal hallucinations in video generation.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from a research-only project to an active open-source repository in April 2026. Recent updates introduced speed-conditioned video generation and the release of the SloMo-44K dataset containing 18 million frames.
